# Await projected authority in the Workstation edge-resize witness

## Context

The [headed failure and discriminator](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/17844#issuecomment-5594955601) at `d8a0fea5cd` reproduce the existing edge-resize witness's stale worker read. Its production and spec inputs match `dev@335b2ca43a`.

## The Problem

After the first left-edge drag, committed extent and rendered geometry have advanced, but `WorkstationEdgeSplitterNL.spec.mjs:311` immediately reads the retained component width as `11%` instead of `17.65536723163842%`. Live preview can satisfy the geometry check while projection is still pending.

A temporary full-spec copy awaited the existing projection promise after observing the commit. All original assertions passed, including both axes, Escape and reducer rejection. The left/bottom waits were 439ms/414ms with no captured projection warnings. The baseline failure remains retained.

## The Architectural Reality

`Workspace.refreshPromise` owns completion of the deferred projection and its completion hooks. `LayoutAdapter.projectEdgeBand` derives the committed percentage; `Reconciler` applies dimensions to retained shells. The existing dotted `call_method` await can observe this owner without a new API.

A handled projection failure can replace the current promise with a retry, so the witness must also reject the existing captured `Dock projection failed` warning.

## The Fix

In the existing edge spec, await projection settlement after observing the new committed extent and before resolving the projected edge splitter/component. Preserve the gesture, geometry, active-tab, Escape, rejection and error assertions. Add a brief explanation of why visible preview is not completion.

## Contract Ledger Matrix

| Surface | Authority | Behavior | Failure | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Edge witness after a committed resize | Workspace refreshPromise; existing dotted call_method await | Wait before resolving final projected component authority | Rejected/missing wait or captured projection warning fails | Local test intent | Retained baseline and complete headed candidate |
| Existing edge acceptance | Current full-spec assertions | Same two-axis geometry, active tab, Escape and rejection checks | Existing tolerances and failure messages stay intact | Existing spec | All four original arms execute |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Both successful edge commits await the current projection after the semantic extent changes, before final projected-component reads.
- [ ] A handled projection failure cannot be reported as clean settlement.
- [ ] Preserve all original gesture paths and geometry, percentage-authority, active-tab, cancellation, rejection and error assertions.
- [ ] Run the complete spec with the explicit Brain runtime, custom E2E config and headed Chrome. Retain before/after evidence and disclose newly exposed failures separately.

## Out of Scope

Production changes, new APIs/helpers, broad NL census repair, the nested-column Escape disappearance, dedicated motion admission tests and PR `#18519` scope changes.

## Avoided Traps

No fixed settlement sleep, forced root pulse, weakened percentage assertion or acceptance based solely on changed DOM geometry.

## Decision Record impact

No ADR or production-contract change; consumes existing projection ownership.

## Sweeps and ownership

Latest 20 live open issues, recent 30 all-state A2A and nine own assignments checked immediately before filing. Own `#18518` explicitly excludes the adjacent edge failure; `#18504`/`#18514` own vessel receipts/frame restoration. Problem-noun MC queries surfaced earlier resize/geometry work but no existing repair for this read; KB lacked an equivalent. Labels verified. This is the sole active implementation claim; existing authored PRs remain at review or human merge gates.
